assemblies.name: SISO Agent Stack
assemblies.summary: The versioned composition that turns intent into coordinated, verifiable, and durable agent work across a project.
assemblies.outcome: A human can state an outcome, agents can execute it through persistent coordinated lanes, and a future agent can recover the verified project state without reconstructing chat.

responsibilities: Expose project architecture, canonical work, claims, run packets, verification, delivery, and durable knowledge.
Persist the state that lets a cold agent resume work without relying on chat or terminal history.

evidence.summary: Project OS README, specification, capability guide, and work lifecycle were read before assigning this assembly role.

components.role: local agent launcher and runtime surface
responsibilities: Launch the coding-agent runtime used by the stack.
Supply the shared status, routing, context, lifecycle, and capability surfaces installed for agents.

evidence.summary: Agent Base README was read directly; it describes a launcher and runtime surface rather than a generic agent framework.

components.role: persistent terminal workspace and lane substrate
responsibilities: Provide workspaces, tabs, panes, durable agent addressing, messaging, and observable persistent lanes.
Host the terminal processes through which the stack coordinates long-running agent work.

evidence.summary: The Herdr skill and its live operating laws were read directly; Herdr supplies mechanics, not a separate SISO control-plane category.

responsibilities: Hold user intent, priorities, lane boundaries, durable context, and final synthesis.
Resolve and coordinate the real workers in Herdr while distinguishing dispatch, worker report, and independent verification.

evidence.summary: The current Agent Zero skill was read directly; it defines a coordination layer and Herdr protocol, not a standalone playbook shelf.

operating_loop.action: Interpret the human outcome against the project's canonical state and constraints.
operating_loop.output: A bounded objective with current facts, ownership, and proof requirements.

operating_loop.action: Choose and brief the appropriate agent capability and execution lane.
operating_loop.output: An explicit work packet and return contract.

operating_loop.action: Run and observe the agent in an addressable terminal lane.
operating_loop.output: Worker artifacts, status, and a returned verdict.

operating_loop.action: Record claims, attempts, independent verification, delivery evidence, and durable learning.
operating_loop.output: Recoverable project truth rather than terminal-only history.

operating_loop.action: Synthesize verified state for the human and select the next bounded action.
operating_loop.output: A closed loop from intent to evidence-backed result.

capability_model.skill: A reusable agent capability with a trigger, bounded instructions, and an expected result contract.
capability_model.playbook: A scenario-specific composition that selects and sequences skills, tools, lanes, evidence, and verification; it may itself be delivered through a skill.
capability_model.placement_rule: Skills and playbooks stay with the component or package that owns their behavior and are indexed across the stack; they are not separate top-level stack layers.

evidence.summary: Assembly derived from direct reading of the current Project OS, Agent Base, Herdr, Agent Zero, orchestration-playbook, and SISO Agent Playbook sources.

source_inventories.name: SISO Agent Base source reallocation inventory

preservation.reason: The parent checkout and nested repositories contain substantial pre-existing work. Extraction requires a content read, a preserved commit or patch, and a bridge before any move.

nested_repositories.preservation: Preserve the SISO WIP branch and dirty files outside the runtime application before changing its location.
Already independent and clean; replace physical nesting with a Library relationship or pinned dependency.
Already independent; preserve four local modifications before removing the nested checkout from the application warehouse.

units.name: SISO coding-agent runtime application
units.rationale: These paths form the installed and launched product shell. Its internal modules receive their own Library identities while remaining packages of one runtime repository until independent release value is proven.

evidence.summary: Installer, launcher, profile projection, loaded extensions, and active TUI sources were read directly.

units.name: Agent control core
units.rationale: This is the runtime backend for routing, child execution, tasks, goals, workflow, mailbox, registries, supervision, tools, worktrees, safety gates, and review. It should first be decomposed into explicit internal domains, not exploded into repositories from filenames.

evidence.summary: All eighty source files and the public extension surface were inventoried by responsibility.

units.name: Agent session lifecycle
units.rationale: The extension has a bounded contract for correction capture, durable lessons, checkpoints, and restore summaries. It is a real module and Library Work candidate, but currently derives its value from the runtime host.

evidence.summary: The exported TypeScript contract and runtime event surface were read directly.

units.name: Agent context manager
units.rationale: The extension owns deterministic distillation, context budgets, retained goals and evidence, child state, mailbox state, memory reads, and compact prompts. It should be a named runtime package with a public contract before any repo split.

evidence.summary: The exported compact-packet types, store surface, distillation export, and host hooks were read directly.

units.name: Agent status and evidence surface
units.rationale: The extension owns the runtime status, widget, notification, message-rendering, and operator command surface. It is separately understandable but remains part of the runtime product.

evidence.summary: The extension API, UI hooks, commands, tool contract, and custom message surface were read directly.

units.name: SISO agent TUI kit
units.rationale: The renderer-neutral contracts, components, adapters, runtime behavior, theme, and OpenTUI application form a reusable presentation module. It should be visible as a Library Work while shipping from the runtime repository initially.

evidence.summary: The package README, renderer boundary, adapters, runtime contract, application entrypoint, and package manifests were inspected.

units.name: SISO Project OS
units.rationale: Project OS is already a clean independent Git repository with its own package, CLI, schemas, tests, license, and accepted Library Work.

evidence.summary: Nested repository remote, clean status, package manifest, README, specification, and lifecycle contracts were verified.

units.name: SISO Agent Playbook
units.rationale: The playbook is already an independently installable Git repository. Its four local modifications must be preserved before the warehouse stops carrying a nested checkout.

evidence.summary: Nested remote, dirty status, installer, skills, tools, prompts, telemetry, and architecture were read directly.

units.name: SISO Foundry
units.rationale: Foundry has an independent outcome, pipeline, databases, research method, and read-only web interface. Code and large datasets require separate storage boundaries.

evidence.summary: Foundry onboarding, source map, pipeline ownership, database boundary, and interface manifest were read directly.

units.name: SISO skills and capability catalog
units.target: siso-skills and promoted individual skill repositories
units.rationale: The runtime currently installs a broad capability catalog by symlink projection. Capabilities need independent identity, evidence, versioning, and promotion without coupling their source to the application release.

evidence.summary: Skill roots, installer projection, capability gate, and representative skill/playbook contracts were read directly.

units.name: SISO cmux fork and WIP
units.rationale: This is a 2.9 GiB upstream cmux repository with a SISO WIP branch and dirty changes. It is not runtime application source and must not be flattened or deleted.

evidence.summary: Upstream remote, local branch, latest WIP commit, dirty state, README, and package manifest were inspected.

units.name: Agent profile composer
units.rationale: The composer has a coherent cross-tool contract for projecting shared behavior into tool-specific profiles. It should be a named runtime package first and graduate only if several products consume it independently.

evidence.summary: Brain README and generated-profile composition contract were read directly.

units.name: Atlas architectural auditor
units.rationale: Atlas presents an independent read-only audit loop, but current operational use and dependencies have not yet been verified.

evidence.summary: Atlas README, rubric, scripts, source map, and ticket surface were inspected.

units.name: SISO Agent Labs
units.target: private siso-agent-lab incubator or vault after comparison
units.rationale: The former Pi Harness Lab is an agent-harness research and build area whose successful runtime work appears partly promoted. Preserve it in a dedicated private agent incubator while comparing unique research and code; do not mix it into the unrelated SISO Internal Lab product repository.

evidence.summary: Lab mission, target architecture, workspaces, experiments, and verification package were read directly.

units.name: SISO web chat
units.rationale: The private Vite package is a read-only web chat command shell with mock-facing source and no established product consumers. Preserve it as an agent-interface prototype until a live product contract justifies promotion.

evidence.summary: Package manifest and current dirty scope were inspected; product state remains unverified.

units.name: SISO design tokens
units.target: SISO shared UI or design-system repository
units.rationale: The package explicitly serves non-agent applications and describes itself as a cross-product design source of truth, so it is filed in the wrong domain.

evidence.summary: Package README, exports, consumers, and license state were inspected.

units.name: Context firewall
units.rationale: This shadow-only, loopback-only measurement rail has an explicit transparency, privacy, smoke-test, and promotion contract. It is an experimental adapter Work, not a core runtime dependency or an independent repository yet.

evidence.summary: The shadow-mode contract, privacy boundary, protocol behavior, isolated smokes, promotion gate, and current verdict were read directly.

units.name: Headroom lossless sidecar adapter
units.rationale: This version-pinned opt-in adapter has a clear safety harness and substantial canary evidence, but global promotion is deliberately blocked on an unmeasurable cache-regression gate. It belongs in an integrations package family until independently adopted.

evidence.summary: The sidecar boundary, lossless rules, launch harness, Oracle contract, live canary, rollback, and non-promotion decision were read directly.

units.name: Knowledge distillation engine
units.rationale: The engine turns long-form sources into traceable structured value items and an evolving taxonomy through a coherent distill-once, route-many pipeline. It should be a Library Work and package; source, generated knowledge, and private operating state must be separated before publication.

evidence.summary: The architecture, live stages, planned stages, data model, runner model, current corpus scale, and sibling-engine relationship were read directly.

units.name: Coding principles evidence engine
units.rationale: The engine harvests sources, gates claims by credibility and evidence, distills them, proposes principles, collects ratings, and promotes canonical guidance. The public name should describe that outcome rather than imply ownership of the Codex product name.

evidence.summary: The harvest-to-render pipeline, credibility tiers, evidence gates, database migration, corpus boundary, and promotion logic were read directly.

units.name: Evidence-gated idea engine
units.rationale: The engine maintains a traceable, score-ranked improvement backlog with groundedness, novelty, layer, and gameability gates plus an explicit lifecycle. It shares an evidence-engine family with the knowledge and coding-principles engines.

evidence.summary: The propose-rate-render pipeline, gates, lifecycle, database dependency, and planning-front-door composition were read directly.

units.name: Agent session intelligence
units.rationale: This subsystem parses Claude and Codex transcripts, extracts evidence-bearing retrospectives, deduplicates and clusters recurring patterns, scores importance, renders recall, and proposes gated improvements. Public extraction requires generic paths and providers, a storage boundary, secret removal and rotation, privacy controls, and fixture-based tests.

evidence.summary: Transcript parsers, retrospective dimensions, evidence quotes, recurrence model, clustering, importance scoring, scheduler, render surface, and provider configuration were read directly.

units.name: Agent brain service
units.rationale: The daemon, client, outbox, health checks, tiered tokens, fleet state, tasks, memory, timeline, costs, notifications, and delegation form a coherent shared agent-state service. Machine names, personal project divisions, private network assumptions, and database migrations must become configuration before publication.

evidence.summary: The daemon contract, HTTP service, SQLite ownership, auth tiers, CLI client, degraded outbox, doctor checks, and machine-specific configuration were read directly.

units.name: Agent Zero boot and rehydration
units.rationale: The boot sequence rehydrates a user-facing coordinating agent from fleet, task, memory, timeline, question, and division state. It belongs to the existing Agent Zero Work rather than becoming a competing standalone repository.

evidence.summary: The boot data contract, degraded behavior, brain writes, briefing, delegation model, and autonomy tiers were read directly.

units.name: Agent voice gateway and dispatch contracts
units.target: siso-agent-zero/packages/voice initially; siso-voice-gateway only after generic adoption
units.rationale: The safer typed-contract slice and the earlier browser-to-Herdr prototype represent one evolving voice interface capability. They should be reconciled under Agent Zero first, preserving plan-only, idempotency, risk-policy, replay, and approval boundaries before any live dispatch or standalone repo.

evidence.summary: The typed request and receipt contract, risk policy, replay fixtures, staged integration gates, browser speech interface, Herdr dispatch prototype, and polling behavior were read directly.

units.name: Research topic registry
units.rationale: The registry creates, fuzzy-matches, links, merges, and preserves research buckets with provenance. Its outcome belongs with Foundry's research catalog unless independent non-Foundry consumers establish a separate release boundary.

evidence.summary: The CLI, schema migration, add-or-match rule, artifact links, merge-without-delete behavior, and current spine dependency were read directly.

units.name: Private and machine runtime state
units.rationale: These areas contain database snapshots, runtime artifacts, telemetry, generated evaluation material, or machine-specific state and are not public application source.

evidence.summary: Top-level contents and runtime database/artifact surfaces were inspected without opening private payloads.

units.name: Archives, research corpora, imports, and upstream source
units.target: reversible vault, Foundry data store, or external-source manifests
units.rationale: These areas have archive, corpus, imported-workspace, legacy, or upstream-source lifecycles and must not be copied as part of an application installation.

evidence.summary: Top-level sizes, repository architecture notes, and lifecycle descriptions were inspected. Individual destructive dispositions require later content reads.

units.name: Cross-domain root scripts and smoke suite
units.target: each extracted Work owns its commands, tests, and release gates
units.rationale: The root package declares 238 scripts, including 208 smoke commands spanning unrelated products. Tests must follow their owning domain during extraction.

evidence.summary: Root script keys, installer checks, file inventory, and representative cross-domain imports were inspected.
First partial machine inventory of the Agent Base warehouse. Unverified units require direct follow-up reads before promotion, movement, or archival.
